## Liability & Reimbursement  
### Customer Liability  
**Zero Liability (Bank Pays All):**
- Unauthorized card use (if reported within 24 hours)
- Account takeover (not customer's fault)
- Stolen check/account details used
- Scam (customer tricked by fraudster impersonating bank)  
**Reduced Liability (Customer Pays Part):**
- Gross negligence (e.g., writing password on card)
- Customer knew fraudster
- Delayed reporting (>24 hours after discovery)  
**Full Customer Liability (Customer Pays All):**
- Authorized transaction (customer authorized but later regrets)
- Negligence (wrote password down, shared card)
- Breach of security (unauthorized person given access)

raw_entities.name: Liability and Reimbursement Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing customer liability for unauthorized transactions, account takeover, and fraud scenarios. Establishes three liability tiers: zero liability (bank pays all), reduced liability (customer pays part), and full customer liability (customer pays all), with specific conditions and reporting timeframes for each.

raw_entities.name: Zero Liability for Unauthorized Card Use
raw_entities.description: Bank assumes full liability for unauthorized card use when the customer reports the incident within 24 hours of discovery. This provision protects customers from financial loss in cases of card fraud.
context: Unauthorized card use (if reported within 24 hours)

raw_entities.name: Zero Liability for Account Takeover
raw_entities.description: Bank assumes full liability for account takeover when it is not the customer's fault. This provision protects customers from unauthorized access to their accounts.

raw_entities.name: Zero Liability for Stolen Check or Account Details
raw_entities.description: Bank assumes full liability when stolen checks or account details are used fraudulently. This provision covers scenarios where customer information is compromised without customer action.

raw_entities.name: Zero Liability for Bank Impersonation Scam
raw_entities.description: Bank assumes full liability when a customer is tricked by a fraudster impersonating the bank. This provision protects customers who are socially engineered into unauthorized transactions.
context: Scam (customer tricked by fraudster impersonating bank)

raw_entities.name: Reduced Liability for Gross Negligence
raw_entities.description: Customer bears partial liability when gross negligence is demonstrated, such as writing a password on a card. This provision establishes shared responsibility when customer security practices are severely deficient.
context: Gross negligence (e.g., writing password on card)

raw_entities.name: Reduced Liability When Customer Knew Fraudster
raw_entities.description: Customer bears partial liability when the fraudster was known to the customer. This provision reflects reduced bank responsibility when the customer had a prior relationship with the perpetrator.

raw_entities.name: Reduced Liability for Delayed Fraud Reporting
raw_entities.description: Customer bears partial liability when fraud is reported more than 24 hours after discovery. This provision incentivizes prompt reporting to minimize bank losses and fraud exposure.

raw_entities.name: Full Customer Liability for Authorized Transactions
raw_entities.description: Customer bears full liability for transactions they authorized, even if they later regret the transaction. This provision establishes that authorization is binding and non-reversible absent fraud or error.
context: Authorized transaction (customer authorized but later regrets)

raw_entities.name: Full Customer Liability for Negligent Security Practices
raw_entities.description: Customer bears full liability when negligence in security practices is demonstrated, such as writing down passwords or sharing card details. This provision holds customers accountable for basic security hygiene.

raw_entities.name: Full Customer Liability for Unauthorized Access Breach
raw_entities.description: Customer bears full liability when they grant unauthorized persons access to their account or card. This provision establishes that customers are responsible for controlling who has access to their banking credentials.
context: Breach of security (unauthorized person given access)

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Card Use
raw_entities.description: Risk of fraudulent use of a customer's payment card by an unauthorized party. The policy addresses this through a 24-hour reporting window and zero liability for the customer when promptly reported.
context: Unauthorized card use (if reported within 24 hours)

raw_entities.name: Account Takeover
raw_entities.description: Risk of unauthorized access to and control of a customer's account by a third party. The policy provides zero liability protection when the takeover is not attributable to customer fault.

raw_entities.name: Stolen Check or Account Details Fraud
raw_entities.description: Risk of fraudulent use of stolen checks or compromised account details. The policy provides zero liability protection when the customer's information is misused without their authorization.

raw_entities.name: Bank Impersonation Scam
raw_entities.description: Risk of customer being deceived by a fraudster impersonating the bank into authorizing unauthorized transactions. The policy provides zero liability protection for customers who are victims of such social engineering.
context: Scam (customer tricked by fraudster impersonating bank)

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Card Use Detection
raw_entities.description: Detection and response obligation for unauthorized card transactions. The policy establishes a 24-hour reporting window within which customers must notify the bank to receive zero liability protection.
context: Unauthorized card use (if reported within 24 hours)

raw_entities.name: Account Takeover Detection
raw_entities.description: Detection and response obligation for unauthorized account access. The policy provides zero liability protection when the takeover is determined to be outside the customer's control.

raw_entities.name: Debit Card
raw_entities.description: Payment card subject to unauthorized use liability provisions. The policy establishes zero liability for unauthorized card use when reported within 24 hours.
context: Unauthorized card use (if reported within 24 hours)

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: Individual customer holding a bank account and subject to liability provisions for unauthorized transactions, fraud, and negligent security practices. The policy establishes tiered liability based on customer actions and reporting timeliness.

raw_entities.name: Bank Account
raw_entities.description: Customer account subject to unauthorized access, takeover, and fraud scenarios covered by the liability and reimbursement policy. The policy establishes liability tiers based on the nature of the unauthorized activity.
context: Breach of security (unauthorized person given access)

properties.core_policy_statement: Bank liability for fraud and unauthorized transactions is tiered based on customer fault, ranging from zero liability for unauthorized card use and account takeover to full customer liability for authorized transactions and security breaches.
properties.scope_summary: Applies to unauthorized card use, account takeover, stolen checks or account details, bank impersonation scams, and authorized transactions. Excludes transactions explicitly authorized by the customer.
